outcome: preterm birth (late preterm, moderate preterm, very preterm, extremely preterm)
cohort: The study included 852 dichorionic diamniotic (DCDA) twin pregnancies, with 591 conceived spontaneously and 261 conceived via assisted reproductive technology.
finding: Maternal and neonatal outcomes in ART-conceived DCDA twin pregnancies are markedly worse compared to those conceived spontaneously.
mod_finding: ART pregnancies were associated with significantly higher rates of cesarean section.
